                                               ORDINANCE
 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing Ml-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 7-N in the area bounded by

The alley next north and parallel to West Grand Avenue; a line 163.35 east of and parallel to North Neva
Avenue; West Grand Avenue; a line 113.35 east of and parallel to North Neva Avenue;



to those of a CI-I Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property:             7128 West Grand Avenue
                    PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                       TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                              7128 W Grand Avenue



Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District

The Applicant seeks a zoning map amendment to operate a butcher shop with wholesale
services at the subject property. 3 parking spaces will be provided. The building is located in a
Transit Served Location and is within 1,300 feet of tlie Mont Clare Station on tiie Metra's
Milwaukee District. The 7,216 SF of commercial space wiU remain. The exterior of the building
will not change.

                        North Setback                   0' (existing)
